title: Nonvanishing of the cube polynomial
statement: For every pair of natural numbers $n,k$ and every sign vector $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$, the value at $S(x)=\sum_{i=1}^n x_i$ of the polynomial $\prod_{j=0}^{k-1}\bigl(X-[2(a+j)-n+1]\bigr)$ is nonzero, where $a=\lfloor(n-k)/2\rfloor$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
